questions.question: What new Zurich application enables developers to work in isolated environments and merge code changes using Git without the risk of overwrites?

explanation.correct: Developer Sandboxes is a new application in the Zurich release that enables administrators and delegated developers to request, access, and manage individual sandboxes on top of the same underlying development instance. Developers can write and merge code and configuration changes without the risk of getting their changes overwritten. See: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/bundle/zurich-release-notes/page/release-notes/now-platform-app-engine/developer-sandboxes-rn.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Update Set Manager is used to manage update sets, not for isolated developer environments with Git integration.
Application Repository stores applications but does not provide isolated development environments.
Instance Clone creates full copies of instances, not isolated developer sandboxes with Git workflows.

source.excerpt: Developer Sandboxes application enables your administrators and delegated developers to request, access, and manage the individual sandboxes on top of the same underlying development instance.

questions.question: Which new Zurich application provides access to external data from Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks without copying it to your ServiceNow instance?

explanation.correct: Workflow Data Fabric Hub is a new application in the Zurich release that unifies data from across the enterprise, providing access to external data in real time without needing to copy it to your instance. It supports Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Databricks, and Oracle. See: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/bundle/zurich-release-notes/page/release-notes/now-platform-app-engine/workflow-data-fabric-rn.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Data Import Manager is used for importing data into ServiceNow, not for accessing external data in real time without copying.
External Data Connector is not the name of this Zurich feature. The correct name is Workflow Data Fabric Hub.
Integration Hub provides integration capabilities but is not the new Zurich application for federated external data access.

references: Zurich Release Notes - Workflow Data Fabric

source.excerpt: Workflow Data Fabric Hub application unifies data from across the enterprise, providing access to external data in real time without needing to copy it to your instance.

questions.question: In Zurich, which new Flow Designer capability allows you to define a schedule once and use it across multiple flows?

explanation.correct: The Zurich release adds the ability to create a reusable scheduled trigger in Flow Designer. This allows you to define a schedule once and reuse it across multiple flows, reducing duplication and ensuring consistency. See: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/bundle/zurich-release-notes/page/release-notes/now-platform-app-engine/flow-designer-rn.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Shared Flow Templates is not the Zurich feature for reusable schedules.
Flow Schedule Library is not the correct terminology for this Zurich feature.
Trigger Inheritance is not a Zurich Flow Designer feature.

source.excerpt: Create a reusable scheduled trigger - allows you to define a schedule once and reuse it across multiple flows.

questions.question: What JavaScript standard is now supported in Zurich that enables Promises and async/await in server-side scripting?

explanation.correct: The Zurich release supports ECMAScript 2021 (ES12) JavaScript mode, which enables additional scripting features including Promises and async/await for server-side scripting. See: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/bundle/zurich-release-notes/page/release-notes/now-platform-administration/core-platform-rn.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: ES6 was supported in earlier releases. Zurich adds ES12 support.
ES9 is not the JavaScript version added in Zurich. ES12 is the new supported standard.
ES14 support is not mentioned in the Zurich release notes.

source.excerpt: Use additional scripting features, including Promises and Async await, with the ECMAScript 2021 (ES12) JavaScript mode.

questions.question: Which new ATF (Automated Testing Framework) feature in Zurich helps identify why tests failed more quickly?

explanation.correct: The Zurich release added ATF Failure Insights, a new feature that helps with faster test failure resolution by providing detailed information about why tests failed. See: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/bundle/zurich-release-notes/page/release-notes/now-platform-capabilities/automated-test-framework-rn.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Test Replay is not the new ATF feature in Zurich for failure analysis.
Debug Mode is not the specific Zurich ATF enhancement for failure insights.
Error Analyzer is not the name of this Zurich ATF feature.

references: Zurich Release Notes - Automated Testing Framework

source.excerpt: The Zurich release added new features like ATF Failure Insights for faster test failure resolution.

questions.question: Which AI model providers are now supported by Now Assist in the Zurich release? (Choose the best answer)

explanation.correct: The Zurich release enhances Now Assist with support for top AI model providers including Gemini, Claude, and Azure OpenAI, providing organizations with flexibility in their AI implementations. See: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/bundle/zurich-release-notes/page/release-notes/analytics-intelligence-reporting/now-assist-rn.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Zurich supports multiple AI providers, not only OpenAI. It includes Gemini, Claude, and Azure OpenAI.
Now Assist in Zurich supports external AI providers, not only ServiceNow proprietary models.
IBM Watson and Google BERT are not the AI providers highlighted in the Zurich Now Assist release notes.

source.excerpt: The Zurich release enhances the Now Assist experience with support for top AI model providers (like Gemini, Claude, Azure OpenAI).

questions.question: In the Zurich release, which feature allows organizations to create a unified experience for handling all types of requests from a single interface?

explanation.correct: Universal Request in Zurich provides a single interface to handle all types of requests including incidents, service catalog requests, HR cases, and IT operations requests. It consolidates multiple request types into one unified experience. See: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/bundle/zurich-release-notes/page/release-notes/now-platform-app-engine/universal-request-rn.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Service Portal is the customer-facing portal for requesting services, not a unified request interface across multiple request types.
Virtual Agent provides conversational AI for automated support, not a unified interface for handling all request types.
Request Management existed before Zurich. Universal Request extends this concept across ALL request types in a single interface.

source.excerpt: Universal Request provides a unified experience to handle all types of requests from a single interface, including incidents, service catalog requests, HR cases, and IT operations requests.

questions.question: Which of the following are new or enhanced capabilities in Virtual Agent in the Zurich release? (Choose three.)

explanation.correct: Zurich enhances Virtual Agent with topic-level analytics for tracking conversation performance, Agentic Actions for autonomous task execution, and PDF-based conversations allowing users to upload PDFs for the AI to read and respond to. See: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/bundle/zurich-release-notes/page/release-notes/now-platform-capabilities/virtual-agent-rn.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Multi-language support existed in Virtual Agent before Zurich.
Facebook Messenger integration is not a new capability in Zurich Virtual Agent.

source.excerpt: Zurich Virtual Agent enhancements include topic-level analytics, Agentic Actions, and PDF-based conversations.

questions.question: What is the purpose of Skills Workspace in ServiceNow Zurich?

options.text: To manage employee skills and competencies for HR purposes
To match agents to work items based on their skills and availability
To create skill-based routing for the Service Catalog
To track skill certifications for compliance

explanation.correct: Skills Workspace in Zurich enables intelligent work assignment by matching agents to tasks based on their skills, experience, and current availability. It provides a modern workspace interface for agents to view and accept work they're qualified for. See: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/bundle/zurich-release-notes/page/release-notes/now-platform-capabilities/skills-workspace-rn.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Skills Workspace is not an HR competency management tool — it's an agent workspace focused on work assignment.
Skill-based routing for the Service Catalog is different from Skills Workspace, which is about agent-to-work matching in a workspace.
Skills Workspace tracks skills for work assignment, not compliance certifications.

source.excerpt: Skills Workspace provides a modern workspace where agents can view and accept work items matched to their skills and availability.

questions.question: In Zurich, what must an administrator configure to enable the new PDF-based conversation feature in Virtual Agent?

options.text: Enable the PDF plugin in the plugin manager
Upload the PDF to the Virtual Agent topic as an attachment
Add the PDF nodes to the topic flow and configure the AI model

explanation.correct: To enable PDF-based conversations in Virtual Agent, administrators must add PDF nodes to the topic flow and configure the AI model to process PDF documents. This allows users to upload PDFs during a conversation and receive AI-generated responses about the document content. See: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/bundle/zurich-release-notes/page/release-notes/now-platform-capabilities/virtual-agent-rn.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: PDF-based conversations don't require a separate plugin — they're configured within the Virtual Agent topic flow.
PDFs aren't uploaded as static attachments — they need to be integrated as conversational nodes in the topic flow.
Document Intelligence is a separate product. PDF conversations use the Virtual Agent topic flow builder.

references: Zurich Release Notes - Virtual Agent PDF Conversations

source.excerpt: PDF-based conversations allow users to upload a PDF document to Virtual Agent and the AI reads and responds to questions about it. Configure this by adding PDF nodes to the topic flow.

questions.question: Which statement correctly describes the Now Create capability introduced in the Zurich release?

options.text: A tool for creating custom applications using low-code drag-and-drop interfaces
An AI-powered feature that generates new knowledge articles from incident resolutions
A rapid app creation tool that uses natural language to generate workflows and integrations
A data import wizard for migrating records from legacy systems

explanation.correct: Now Create is an AI-powered feature in Zurich that enables rapid creation of applications using natural language. Users describe what they want in plain language, and Now Create generates the underlying workflows, integrations, and UI components. See: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/bundle/zurich-release-notes/page/release-notes/now-platform-app-engine/now-create-rn.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: App Engine Studio is the low-code drag-and-drop tool for building custom applications. Now Create is AI-powered natural language app creation.
AI-generated knowledge articles from incidents is a different feature. Now Create is about creating applications, not knowledge articles.
Data import wizards and migration tools are separate capabilities. Now Create generates new application components from natural language descriptions.

source.excerpt: Now Create uses generative AI to enable rapid app creation. Users describe what they want to build using natural language, and Now Create generates the underlying components.

questions.question: Which capabilities were enhanced in the Automated Testing Framework (ATF) in the Zurich release? (Choose two.)

explanation.correct: ATF in Zurich added Failure Insights for faster test failure diagnosis, and Quick Start test suites for rapid creation of test suites. See: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/bundle/zurich-release-notes/page/release-notes/now-platform-capabilities/automated-test-framework-rn.html

wrongAnswers.explanation: Test result export to Excel was not a new ATF feature in Zurich.
Cross-instance test execution is not a Zurich ATF enhancement.
Automated regression detection is not a feature mentioned in the Zurich ATF release notes.

references: Zurich Release Notes - Automated Testing Framework

source.excerpt: Zurich ATF enhancements include Failure Insights for faster debugging and Quick Start test suites for rapid test suite creation.
